_comment: Drives the link-in-bio page at /links (served as https://shauna.dev/).
Adding a link = adding one entry. Nothing else needs to change.
bars[].variant  plain | dark | teal | tint | quiet   (see links.astro rest-state block)
bars[].span     grid columns out of 6. Everything is 6 today; 3 gives a half-width bar.
bars[].href     omit or null + "placeholder": true to render a non-linking TBD bar.
The Writing section is NOT listed here. It is generated from the blog content
collection so the latest post and the post count stay correct on their own.
latestPostSlug pins which post is 'latest' because two posts share a
publishedDate (2026-07-27) and a plain date sort cannot break that tie.
Remove the pin and it falls back to newest-by-date.
